name: SCHOOL_ZONE_{speed}_SCHOOL_DAYS_ORANGE_TALL
legend: SCHOOL ZONE {speed} 7-9 AM 2-4 PM SCHOOL DAYS
notes: TMR Queensland design sheet (Q-series book / TC-series), colour drawing 'not to scale' with a lettered dimension table; every dimension from the sheet, AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. The sheets give no letter widths, so there is no width check. Sheet 'c' is the white edge and 'd' the edge + border (read as AS 1743 does: 10/30 = edge 10 + border 20, 5/15 = 5 + 10, 15/45 = 15 + 30), confirmed against the national R-series pairs. Q-series sheet R4-040-Q01_1 'School zone speed limit' (2025; page 2 = time set-out options, page 3 = the SEQ times overlay). Size A generated (target board a1 600 x b1 1550, r3 100, fluorescent orange edge strip c1 75 all round; the white sign a 450 x b 1400, r 45; B 800 x 2100 / 600 x 1900 and C 1200 x 3100 / 900 x 2800 also tabled). Sections c 300 (school zone plate) / d 500 (speed) / e 600 (times and SCHOOL DAYS) = 1400. Plate: f 4 white gap from the sign edge, black border g 12, fluorescent yellow-green inside, r 45 (sign coordinates y 4-300, x 4-446); chain f 4 / k 50 / m 75D SCHOOL / n 46 / m 75D ZONE / k 50 = 300 (k includes the 12 border): SCHOOL cap top 54, ZONE 175. Speed: o 150 / p 200D / o 150 = 500: numerals cap top 450, red annulus r2 220 outside / r1 185 inside centred (225, 550). Times panel: black border g 12, y 800-1396 (the white gap f 4 only below it, as the sheet's vectors draw it), r 45. Chain q 325 (times block) / s 40 / t 75D SCHOOL / s 40 / t 75D DAYS / u 45 = 600: SCHOOL cap top 1165, DAYS 1280. Times block per page 3 of R4-040-Q01 (R4-040-Q01_3 = R4-040-Q02_4, the 400 x 330 overlay 'to be used for all school zone speed limit signs in South East Queensland', option 1 of the set-out page, whole hours): 7 - 9 AM / 2 - 4 PM, numerals f 120C, AM/PM d 45D on the numerals' baseline, rows e 75 + d 45 = 120 with g 40 between, c 25 above (numeral cap tops 825 and 985); horizontal k 24 / m 110 (first numeral, left-aligned) / n 30 (the dash) / o 42 / p 170 (second numeral + AM) / k 24 = 400, the block centred in the 450 sign (x 25-425): first numeral ink at x 49, dash a 30 x 8 bar at x 159-189 centred on the cap mid-height (its thickness and height measured from the sheet), second numeral at 231, AM/PM ink ending at 401; run gaps computed from the AS 1744 ink widths (7 / 9 / 2 = 67.2, 4 = 74.4, AM 80.1, PM 72.5). DISAGREEMENT: page 1 tables the AM/PM as w 60C with an x 45D (the '30' of the half-hour options); the overlay page's 45D AM/PM is used because it is the dimensioned whole-hour layout. Times are 'insert appropriate value': the SEQ standard 7-9 AM / 2-4 PM is generated; other times and the half-hour options are not. Speed 'insert appropriate' (40 shown): 40 generated with 60 and 80, the school zone limits used in Queensland (Russell: the variants that make sense, not every value). Colours: fluorescent orange (drawn as the pack's orange), fluorescent yellow-green, red, white, black. All elements offset (75, 75) for the target board.
